data.title: 橘美花莉 · 巧克力盒上的蝴蝶结
data.description: 美花莉穿灰粉针织衫和象牙白半围裙坐在餐桌前，用细缎带给巧克力盒打结。栗棕色的长发在两侧各扎着小蝴蝶结垂在胸前。她发现缎带两边长短不一，抿起嘴唇拆开重来；桌上散落的备选小盒见证了这份专一的深情。
data.action: 拆开不对称的蝴蝶结，认真重新系好，粉眸专注
data.promptProse: Mikari Tachibana holds two satin ribbon ends above a small chocolate box, noticing that the loops are uneven. She presses her lips together and patiently unties the bow to try again. A dusty-rose knit top and ivory waist apron contrast with the charcoal long skirt. Soft afternoon light falls across her chestnut brown hair tied into two-side-up bunches with pink ribbons, focused pink eyes and several spare paper boxes on the dining table. Use a close seated view with clear hands and no printed messages or other figures.
